Peninsula Sauna & Spa has been running out of a quiet street in Seaford since the early 1990s, which, by the standards of nude sauna venues in suburban Melbourne, makes it something of an institution. The specifics of the facility (sauna type, pool configuration, amenities) aren’t listed anywhere publicly, so what follows is drawn from what is known: it’s a nude venue, it’s been doing this for over thirty years, and it has a small but loyal regular crowd.

By the standards of nude sauna venues in suburban Melbourne, it’s something of an institution, running since the early 1990s out of a quiet street in Seaford.

The venue runs a calendar of themed sessions rather than a single flat offering. Xposed Nude Sunday operates noon to 8:00pm on Sundays and costs $25 entry, making it the clearest entry point if you’re going for the first time. Mates Rates and HUMP Nude Night both run 6:00pm to 10:30pm, though the specific days for those sessions aren’t listed publicly. General hours run Monday, Wednesday and Thursday noon to 10:30pm; Tuesday, Friday and Saturday noon to 6:30pm; Sunday noon to 8:00pm.

Google ratings sit at 4.1 from 14 reviews, a small sample, but the tone skews warm among regulars. Staff are mentioned by name in more than one review, which tends to suggest the kind of place where the same faces show up week after week. One reviewer described a good first experience on the Sunday session; another has visited multiple times and has clear preferences about the space.

The sauna type isn’t listed publicly, so that’s worth confirming directly if it matters to you. What is clear is that nudity is the baseline, not an option: all the named events operate on that basis, so go in knowing that’s the format. The venue is at 16 Cumberland Drive, Seaford. You can reach them on (03) 9776 9279.

FAQ

Is nudity required?
Yes, Peninsula Sauna operates as a nude venue. The regular events, including the Sunday session and HUMP Nude Night, are explicitly nude.
What events run regularly?
The recurring sessions are Xposed Nude Sunday (12:00pm–8:00pm), Mates Rates (6:00pm–10:30pm), and HUMP Nude Night (6:00pm–10:30pm). The specific days for the latter two aren't listed on the venue's website.
How much does it cost?
The Xposed Nude Sunday session is $25. Pricing for other sessions isn't publicly listed.
What are the opening hours?
Monday, Wednesday and Thursday noon to 10:30pm; Tuesday, Friday and Saturday noon to 6:30pm; Sunday noon to 8:00pm.
How long has it been open?
It opened in the early 1990s, making it one of the longer-running venues of its kind in the region.
